checks.finding: The closed iso and top views show one base, one lid, one display opening, four lid fasteners and four display fasteners.
The 88 by 63 mm enclosure surrounds the native 70 by 45 mm carrier with separate perimeter standoffs. The open top render matches the carrier outline and left USB notch.
The display surface is visible through the rectangular lid aperture. The open interior views show the left-facing XIAO USB envelope at the open-top wall notch.
The closed assembly has no detached exterior bodies. The interior view hides the documented lid/display subassembly and shows the carrier, controller envelope and mounting hardware inside the base.
The carrier fasteners align with four corner mounts, and four tall perimeter standoffs meet the seated lid. The display is retained by four dedicated fasteners around its window.
The top view uses screen-right +X and screen-up +Y. The XIAO USB faces -X, the OLED faces +Z, and the native registration gauges independently check three PCB pad centres in Y=-editorY.
The closed top/iso and open top/iso views agree on the one case, offset display, left USB access, carrier mounts and perimeter lid hardware.

findings: Reviewed actual OCCT renders of the corrected source, including closed and open interior iso/top views.
The native PCB keeps its +Z populated side. Authored primitive geometry converts to Y=-editorY before boolean construction; catalog fasteners retain rigid transforms.
The 12 evaluated requirements include three independent native pin-centre gauges and preserve the 1.277 mm glass/support and 0.500 mm glass/lid gaps.
Printed fit, incoming module tolerances, cable routing, tool clearance margins and physical assembly remain untested.
